data.name: Ravi
data.gender_notes: Ravi is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ravi, 'sun', from the root rav, 'to roar, to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit rav (रव्). A classical Sanskrit name of the sun. Ravi is a Sanskrit name meaning “The sun”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ravi expresses “The sun”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ravi, 'sun', from the root rav, 'to roar, to shine'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ravi total 23, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

vedic_reference.note: Ravi is a name derived from the Sanskrit word रवि (ravi), which means 'sun'. In Hindu mythology, Ravi is the name of the Sun God. It is also mentioned in various Vedic texts, such as the Rigveda and the Atharvaveda.

historical_references.reference: A classical Sanskrit name of the sun.
